meta.promptText: Dark spots aur dull skin ke liye India mein konsa vitamin C serum kharidun?

response.text:
Dark spots (pigmentation) aur dull skin ke liye India mein kai acche aur effective Vitamin C serums available hain. Yeh serums skin ko bright banate hain, uneven skin tone ko theek karte hain aur spots ko fade karne mein madad karte hain.

Aapki skin type aur budget ke hisaab se yeh kuch best options hain:

---

### Top Vitamin C Serums in India

| Serum & Brand | Key Ingredients | Best For |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Minimalist 10% Vitamin C Serum** | Ethyl Ascorbic Acid, Centella Water, Acetyl Glucosamine | Beginners se lekar intermediate users tak, glowing aur clear skin ke liye. |
| **Plum 15% Vitamin C Face Serum** | Ethyl Ascorbic Acid, Mandarin, Kakadu Plum | Dull skin aur fresh glow ke liye, lightweight formula. |
| **Garnier Bright Complete Vitamin C Serum** | 30x Vitamin C, Lemon, Yuzu Lemon | Budget-friendly option, daily use aur mild dark spots ke liye. |
| **Deconstruct Vitamin C & E Serum** | 10% Vitamin C, 0.5% Ferulic Acid | Pigmentation aur dark spots target karne ke liye powerful combination. |
| **Klairs Freshly Juiced Vitamin Drop** | 5% Ascorbic Acid, Centella Asiatica | Sensitive skin ke liye jo strong serums se irritate ho jaati hai. |
| **The Derma Co. 10% Vitamin C Serum** | Vitamin C, Niacinamide, Ferulic Acid | Acne marks aur hyperpigmentation ko jaldi light karne ke liye. |

---

### Kuch Zaroori Baatein (Tips for Best Results)

* **Patch Test Zaroor Karein:** Agar aap pehli baar Vitamin C use kar rahe hain, toh skin par choti jagah laga kar check kar lein ki koi allergy ya irritation toh nahi ho rahi.
* **Sunscreen Hai Zaroori:** Vitamin C lagane ke baad din mein **Sunscreen** lagana bilkul na bhulein, warna sun damage se spots aur dark ho sakte hain.
* **Consistent Rachein:** Vitamin C apna asar dikhane mein kam se kam 3 se 4 hafte ka samay leta hai, isliye ise regular routine mein shamil karein.
